title: AI加速药物发现：医疗主题再提速，谁最先受益？
speaker: Nicholas Choi

segments.en: So that's, I think, where it's very exciting. Now, AI, I think, is going to speed up the drug discovery process. And that, I think, will supercharge this thematic even further.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是非常令人兴奋的地方。现在，AI将加速药物发现过程。我认为这将进一步推动这一主题。

segments.en: Obviously, AI is still relevant in the other parts, like medical devices, as you plug it in to the entire system, hospitals, et cetera. But I think the most immediate beneficiaries on drug discovery.
segments.zh: 显然，AI在其他部分仍然相关，比如医疗设备，当你把它接入整个系统、医院等。但我认为最直接的受益者是在药物发现。

segments.en: Yeah, and for our viewers, we'll have something special for you guys on this topic tomorrow.
segments.zh: 是的，对于我们的观众，明天我们将就这个话题为你们准备特别内容。
